Production Worker - Day Shift 
Are you looking for a stable day shift job in production? Do you enjoy working with your hands and learning technical skills? We are looking for motivated Production Workers to join a metal manufacturing company that produces insulated cold storage panels used in supermarkets and hospitals. This is a great opportunity for international and English-speaking candidates who want long-term work in the Netherlands. What are you going to do? 
You will work in a production team where precision and quality are very important. Metal work must be done carefully, because once it is cut or bent, it cannot be changed. 
Your tasks include: - Operating metal cutting machines - Bending metal sheets (press brake work) - Punching corners and preparing panels - Filling panels with insulating foam using a machine - Working together with colleagues so installation teams can easily assemble the panels on location 
 What do we offer you? - €14.99 gross per hour, plus allowances according to the Metalworking Collective Labour Agreement - Guaranteed 38 hours per week - Day shift only - working hours approx. - Possibility of a permanent contract with the company after some time - Training and daily learning opportunities in metalworking - An open, informal, and international-friendly work environment - Pride in working on a high-quality product used throughout the Netherlands What do you need? - Experience in production or manufacturing (metal experience is a plus) - You speak English or Dutch - Basic technical understanding or willingness to learn - You work accurately, responsibly, and proactively - You are available for full-time work - You are physically fit and able to perform physical production work safely
